profit_quality.assessment: 2023 reported profit recovered, and operating cash flow was strong, but distributable cash must deduct capital expenditure and lease principal because restaurant leases are essential to continued operations. Main pre-haircut sustainable cash profit uses the 2021-2023 median of operating cash flow less PPE capex less lease principal: RMB55.741 million. The main haircut factor is 0.70 because 2021-2022 were pandemic-affected, 2023 benefited from reopening, store count still declined, and exact maintenance capex is not disclosed.
adjustments: Removed reliance on fair value gains from FVTPL assets, FVTPL liabilities and investment properties when judging recurring cash profit.
Deducted lease principal repayments from operating cash flow because IFRS cash flow presents them in financing activities.
Used the three-year median lease-adjusted owner cash profit rather than only the 2023 recovery year.
Treated 2023 PPE purchase of RMB65.566 million as maintenance/conservative capex because no maintenance/growth split is disclosed.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Restaurant cash conversion improved in 2023, but the multi-year sample includes pandemic disruption and store closures; exact maintenance capex and lease renewal economics remain uncertain.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: 2023 OCF/reported parent net profit was about 2.78x, helped by depreciation and lease accounting, but cash available to owners is much lower after lease principal.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: No exact split; 2023 purchase of property, plant and equipment of RMB65.566 million is used as conservative maintenance capex.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2023 working capital movement was roughly neutral in aggregate; inventory release offset receivable growth.
